audit.reasoning: The classification (penultimate, fixed-dominant) rests on the standard and only published description of Lote, a 2008 SIL reference-style grammar sketch by a fieldworker with 20+ years in the community, and the deciding sentence is confirmed verbatim at sec. 2.4 p. 14 in a copy we hold (now also filed in the working files); same-page phonetic transcriptions independently show penultimate stress. The record's grade/quote/cite/loc fields are empty even though the source text is verified, so the evidence grade should be set to primary-source-verified with locator 'sec. 2.4, p. 14'. The statement is categorical with no listed exceptions, so 'fixed' (strict) would also be defensible, but a two-sentence sketch statement restricted to 'isolated words and noun phrases' is a reasonable basis for keeping dominant rather than strict; no recode is warranted on present evidence.
